stem: A hiker starts at an elevation of 2,150 meters and descends at a steady rate of 12 meters per minute. What is the least whole number of minutes after which her elevation will be below 1,500 meters?
solution: After \(m\) minutes her elevation is \(2{,}150 - 12m\) meters. It must be below \(1{,}500\): \(2{,}150 - 12m < 1{,}500\).
Subtract \(2{,}150\): \(-12m < -650\). Divide by \(-12\) and reverse the sign: \(m > 54.16...\).
After 54 minutes she is at \(1{,}502\) meters, still not below \(1{,}500\); after 55 minutes she is at \(1{,}490\) meters. The answer is 55.
verify:
m = symbols('m')
S = solve_univariate_inequality(2150 - 12*m < 1500, m, relational=False)
assert S == Interval.open(Rational(325, 6), oo)
least = min(n for n in range(0, 200) if n in S)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [least] == [55]
